description: A first-order formula \(\varphi(\bar x)\) is preserved under extensions between nonempty models of \(T\) if and only if it is equivalent modulo \(T\) to an existential formula in the same language and free-variable context.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.Preservation.extension_preserved_iff_existential.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  {T : L.Theory} {n : ℕ} (φ : L.Formula (Fin n)) :
  Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.Preservation.ExtensionPreserved T φ ↔
    ∃ ψ, FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormula.IsExistential ψ ∧ T ⊨ᵇ φ.iff ψ
